# PAYAMAKE

PAYAMAKE is a Persian-language SMS marketing and messaging service focused on targeted SMS campaigns, specialized phone-number databases, campaign execution, and messaging tools.

## Main pages

- https://payamake.ir/
- https://payamake.ir/blog/index.html
- https://payamake.ir/blog/sms-marketing-guide/
- https://payamake.ir/blog/how-to-write-promotional-sms/
- https://payamake.ir/blog/best-time-to-send-promotional-sms/

## Main topics

- Targeted SMS marketing
- SMS campaign management
- Specialized phone-number databases
- SMS pricing and campaign planning
- SMS API and integrations
